That commit is already an ancestor of both the worker branch and the combined branch.
additional_context: The seed was filed from the #committers FHIR-19977 Zulip thread, where Grahame Grieve said THO should be used and the duplicate core artifact deleted for R6. FHIR-I WGM minutes record the FHIR-41668 Persuasive with Modification vote. The older FHIR-19977 code request was implemented in THO through UTG proposal UP-299, and the THO CodeSystem currently includes MSG_EXTERNAL_FAIL. FHIR-37866 is related R4B context but is not Applied/Published and its Jira comment says the issue was fixed in R5.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source no longer defines the old operation-outcome ValueSet/CodeSystem in source/terminologies, and source/auditevent/valueset-audit-event-outcome-detail-example.xml composes from http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/operation-outcome. Current build pages for valueset-operation-outcome.html and codesystem-operation-outcome.html return 404, while valueset-audit-event-outcome-detail-example.html expands from the THO CodeSystem.
